title: UCB bandit
notes: NON-PARSING real-book-syntax-bug (multiple). First reported error: line 52 ends the statement with a dangling binary operator `... ) /` followed by a blank line and a continuation `Self.n_values[...]` -- a line cannot end with `/` outside brackets, so implicit continuation does not apply -> SyntaxError 'invalid syntax'. Additional bugs that still bite after fixing the `/`: (a) `Self.n_values` capital-S typo (should be `self`); (b) `return arm` is dedented to 2 spaces, placing it at class-body level after select_arm instead of inside it -> 'return outside function' AND select_arm would return None. Fix = join the two lines into one `... ) / self.n_values[chosen_arm]`, lowercase `self`, and indent `return arm` to 4 spaces inside select_arm. Verified the corrected UCBAlgorithm runs a 20-step simulation. Only np is needed (available), so it is standalone once the syntax is fixed.

title: linucb disjoint policy implementation
provides: <syntax error: unindent does not match any outer indentation level @ line 13>
notes: NON-PARSING real-book-syntax-bug: `def __init__` is at 4 spaces but `def select_arm` is at 2 spaces -> IndentationError (line 30 of figure). Depends on linucb_disjoint_arm (L15.10). ALGORITHMIC bugs verified after fixing indentation: (1) the tie-breaker `if arm_ucb == highest_ucb` is nested INSIDE the `if arm_ucb > highest_ucb` block right after `highest_ucb = arm_ucb`, so it is always true and merely duplicates the current arm; genuine ties on other arms are never collected (3 tied arms -> candidate_arms=[0,0] instead of [0,1,2]) -- it should be an `elif` at the same level as the `>` test. (2) every arm is built with the hardcoded `arm_index = 1` (loop var `i` is ignored; should be `arm_index=i`). Fix = normalise indentation, change the nested `if` to a sibling `elif`, and use `arm_index=i`.
